meta.title: Tampa Bay Mortgage Lenders
meta.description: Mortgage lenders and brokers serving The NOW Team's 8-county Tampa Bay service area. Data sourced from Google Places.
meta.disclaimer: The NOW Team provides this list as a convenience. We do not endorse, receive compensation from, or steer clients to any lender. You are free to choose any lender. We encourage comparing rates, fees, and terms, and verifying licensing at nmlsconsumeraccess.org.

lenders.name: 14 Days To Close
lenders.address: 450 Knights Run Ave Unit 5, Tampa, FL 33602
lenders.bio: One of the most-reviewed mortgage teams in the bay area, built around fast closings and clear, patient guidance. First-time buyers praise how they break down costs and percentages until everything makes sense.

lenders.name: The Orlicki Group
lenders.address: 401 E Jackson St Ste 2340, Tampa, FL 33602
lenders.bio: A Tampa team realtors and buyers pick for competitive rates, transparency, and quick execution. Strong communication, a smooth document system, and honest second opinions when you are rate shopping.

lenders.name: Bliss Mortgage LLC
lenders.address: 5322 Primrose Lake Cir A, Tampa, FL 33647
lenders.bio: A five-star Tampa broker known for educating first-time and condo buyers before they ever make an offer. Fast pre-approvals, constant communication with all parties, and a website that walks you through the process.

lenders.name: Jim Gaffney - Union Home Mortgage
lenders.bio: A Valrico-based lender realtors trust to get deals to the closing table smoothly. A responsive team with strong attention to detail and clear communication at every step.

lenders.name: Wholesale Mortgages LLC
lenders.address: 205 E Brandon Blvd Ste A, Brandon, FL 33511
lenders.bio: A Brandon mortgage broker praised for stepping in fast when other lenders stall, sometimes closing in days. Efficient, professional, and experienced with FHA and first-time buyer loans.

lenders.name: DDA Mortgage
lenders.address: 1600 W Bay Dr Ste B, Largo, FL 33770
lenders.bio: A Largo broker that guides buyers from shopping and pre-approval all the way to closing with honesty and detail. Responsive and knowledgeable, and comfortable with first-time buyers and investment properties alike.

lenders.name: Clearwater Mortgage
lenders.bio: A Clearwater team that makes first-time buying feel manageable, with friendly, efficient service from pre-approval to close. Buyers highlight fast turnaround and steady support through every obstacle.

lenders.name: McCaughan Home Lending
lenders.bio: A Clearwater lender (powered by Lower) known for organized, thorough, and responsive service. An easy-to-use loan app keeps you informed, and no detail gets overlooked on the way to a timely close.

lenders.name: My Easy Mortgage
lenders.address: 2405 Creel Ln STE 102, Wesley Chapel, FL 33544
lenders.bio: A Wesley Chapel broker with hundreds of five-star reviews across purchases and refinances. Attentive, patient service that handles curveballs like roof or insurance issues without missing a beat.

lenders.name: Neighborhood Loans - Lakeland
lenders.bio: A high-volume Lakeland lender realtors rave about for proactive communication and getting deals done. A dedicated team that helps buyers who were turned down elsewhere find a path to closing.

lenders.name: Loantrust Mortgage Inc
lenders.bio: A Lakeland broker praised for making the process feel like a breeze, often closing in under 30 days. Clear communication and a document process that keeps first-time buyers out of the dark.

lenders.name: Simple Lending Mortgage LLC
lenders.bio: A Lakeland team that keeps first-time and out-of-state buyers informed and confident from start to close. Quick to respond and able to pivot fast, even switching loan types days before closing when needed.

lenders.name: JZ Mortgage Services, Inc.
lenders.bio: A Bradenton lender realtors and title companies have trusted for years, known for transparency and follow-through. Handles every client with care and stays available when questions come up.

lenders.name: Thurber Financial Group LLC
lenders.address: 1023 Manatee Ave W Ste 310, Bradenton, FL 34205
lenders.bio: A Bradenton lender clients trust for honesty, integrity, and meticulous attention to detail. Prompt, professional communication that makes a big financial decision feel manageable.

lenders.name: Dustin Meshberger (Suncoast Mortgage)
lenders.address: 235 N Orange Ave Unit 200, Sarasota, FL 34236
lenders.bio: A Sarasota mortgage team first-time buyers recommend for responsive, after-hours service and clear explanations. Smooth process from initial contact to closing, with someone always available to answer questions.

lenders.name: Pathway Mortgage
lenders.bio: A Sarasota lender that goes above and beyond to close tough deals, even for out-of-state buyers. Resourceful, responsive, and communicative from pre-approval through the closing table.

lenders.name: Affordable Home Loans
lenders.bio: A Sarasota lender realtors endorse for strategy, foresight, and putting the client first. Immediate responses, clear options, and smooth closings, even on complex files.

lenders.name: Supreme Lending - Spring Hill
lenders.address: 10480 Spring Hill Dr, Spring Hill, FL 34608
lenders.bio: A Spring Hill lender praised for friendly, informative service on purchases and refinances. A responsive team that answers every question and moves quickly toward closing.

lenders.name: Suarez Home & Finance Corp.
lenders.address: 3087 Anderson Snow Rd, Spring Hill, FL 34609
lenders.bio: A Spring Hill lender that puts nervous first-time buyers at ease with patient, clear guidance. Easy to reach and thorough, with a range of loan and HELOC options.

lenders.name: Citrus Mortgage Associates, LLC
lenders.bio: A local Inverness broker Citrus County families trust to put clients first and chase the best rate. Diligent, detail-oriented, and available early morning through late night to keep things moving.

lenders.name: American Mortgage Lenders of ALCOVA Mortgage
lenders.bio: A Crystal River loan officer known for finding a way when banks say no. Frequent communication, clear explanations, and a smooth process from application to closing.

lenders.name: Rich Reynolds - Highland Mortgage
lenders.bio: A Tampa lender Barrett personally recommends, with a reputation among agents for closing on time and with no surprises. More than 15 years in the business and a go-to for buyers who want a lender that delivers.

lenders.name: Christian Gardner - CMG Home Loans
lenders.address: 4902 Eisenhower Blvd S Ste 235, Tampa, FL 33634
lenders.bio: A Tampa CMG Home Loans officer Barrett personally recommends for steady communication and follow-through, even on long, cross-country relocations. Keeps clients confident through the process and closes cleanly.

lenders.name: Paul George - Simplified Mortgage
lenders.bio: A Tampa-area loan officer with Simplified Mortgage, personally recommended by Barrett for buyers who want straightforward, hands-on guidance through financing.
